release_name: Movies: find, download and organize movies automatically
highlights: New Movies page: library, Discover (TMDb), Downloads and Settings. New digital and Blu-ray releases that pass your rating, vote, language and genre filters are added automatically, searched on your existing indexers (movie categories, IMDb ID first) and sent to your existing SABnzbd/NZBGet/torrent client under a movies category or label

Completed downloads are renamed to Title (Year)/Title (Year).ext in the movie library (Usenet moved, torrents hardlinked so they keep seeding) and every enabled Plex server scans the new folder. Failed or stalled releases are blocklisted and another release is searched
The movie library folder is detected from Plex; movies already in Plex or the library folder are recognized before anything is searched, so nothing you own is downloaded again
